items.requirement: Concurrent reserve attempts against the same SKU must not oversell available stock.
items.rationale: Inventory integrity is the core risk.
items.threshold: No two held reservations may sum above physical available+held accounting; oversell attempts fail with named domain error.
items.measurement: Contract tests for concurrent or sequential race fixtures; OCL invariants on available/held.

items.requirement: Only authorized principals may create or release holds for a SKU.
items.rationale: AuthZ boundary without full IAM product.
items.threshold: Unauthorized principal always receives named authz domain error; no hold mutation.
items.measurement: API/contract tests with unauthorized principal fixture.

items.requirement: N/A — no latency SLO for framing sample.
